# Fiscal golden fixtures

The checked-in `source.xlsx`, `reports.xlsx`, and `meta.txt` are engine
self-consistency regression goldens generated by:

```text
python scripts/make_engine_golden.py
```

They detect changes in fiscal report generation and Excel export. They are not
claimed to be an Apps Script reference.

To validate against Google Sheets instead, replace the source and report
workbooks with a real `Vay_Reports_Fixed.gs` export and keep the matching report
date in `meta.txt` (`YYYY-MM-DD`). The tests will then compare against GS. Sheet
names may be the original report IDs or the 31-character Excel names.

Comparisons are by entity key rather than row index, with a numeric tolerance
matching `#,##0.00`.
